tei:div.tei:p: ye shes rab 'bar las: gos sngon can gyi za yig: ྈྈྈྈྈ ye shes rab 'bar gtso bor phyag 'tshal bstod: che btsan 'gran bral dmar nag he ru ka'i: thugs klong gsang ba'i bdag po mngon par 'khrungs: bzhad pa'i snying rjes 'gro la chags pa'i phyir: 'gro ba'i zug rngu 'byin phyir yi ge 'di: rdzas sngags mi dgos za ba kho nas chog: thog mar gnam lcags thog gi srung ba bstan: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ zos na thog gi 'jigs pa srung bar byed: bzhag na thog gi 'jigs pa srung bar byed: ྈྈྈ 'dogs na thog gi 'jigs pa srung bar byed: thog zer phog pas slar zos 'tsho bar 'gyur: skar mda' ltung ba 'tsho bar byed: skar mda' ltung ba srung bar byed: sde brgyad gdong thug gi dug srung bar byed:
